# Bugfix Log

## Bugfix: AI diet chart not South Indian, not editable — 2026-11-10 13:01

**Fixed at:** 2026-11-10 13:01
**Flow affected:** AI assistant diet plan
**Issue:** The diet chart generated by the AI assistant suggested generic / North Indian food (rotis etc.), could not be edited, and only had a small "Print" link at the top.
**Root cause:** `ChatbotOpenAiClient.java` DIET_PROMPT asked for a generic "Indian" plan with "2 rotis" as its portion example; `DietPlanCard.tsx` rendered the plan read-only with no edit state or bottom actions.
**Fix:** The prompt now always requires South Indian (Tamil Nadu style) dishes and portions and excludes North Indian staples unless a clinical rule needs them. DietPlanCard keeps the plan in local state, adds bottom "Edit" and "Download" buttons, makes summary, meals, avoid and tips editable inline, and shows "Save & Download" (plus Cancel) while editing; download uses the existing print helper (Save as PDF). Edits are not persisted, same as before.
**Files:** senhmsbackend-main/src/main/java/com/hms/modules/chatbot/client/ChatbotOpenAiClient.java, senhmsfrontend-main/app/_components/chatbot/DietPlanCard.tsx
